{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blouse: relaxed-fit v-neck blouse, hip length, pale blue (#dfe8f2), matte silk-blend crepe, tucked in at the front
Trousers: high-waisted straight-leg trousers, ankle length, charcoal (#3b4250), wool-blend crepe
Blazer: single-breasted textured blazer, softly structured, hip length, slate navy (#2f3e5c), wool-blend herringbone
Loafers: almond-toe loafers with a low block heel, burgundy (#5b2c3a), smooth leather
Belt: slim belt with a small matte silver buckle, burgundy (#5b2c3a), leather
Bag: structured medium tote with top handles, burgundy (#5b2c3a), grained leather
Earrings: small round studs, soft silver (#c0c4cc), polished metal

This outfit sits right at neat business casual: a blouse with trousers, a textured jacket and loafers. The cool pale blue near the face echoes your eye color, and the slate navy and charcoal let your silvery hair stand out. Tucking the blouse into high-waisted trousers with a slim belt gives a clean, defined line. The straight leg and hip-length blazer keep the proportions balanced, and the burgundy accents add warmth that suits autumn."}
